title: Juice N Power Sour Apple Ice Power Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Sour Apple from Juice N Power is candy apple flavour with real character. The mouth-watering hard candy apple taste brings a rush of sharp, sour satisfaction that ends with a deliciously sweet and smooth exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
